description: Routing case — a genuine Google Drive lookup routes to Drive Agent. PR #162 deliberately tightened Drive routing; case 033 only asserts the NEGATIVE (ambiguous tenant complaints stay out of Drive). This is the missing POSITIVE assertion (#190): an over-correction that made Drive unreachable on valid lookups would otherwise go undetected. The explicit 'in my Google Drive' disambiguates from the Buildium leases domain; must_not_route_to forbids Buildium/Web/Browser/Gmail.

input.user_message: Find the lease agreement for unit 3B in my Google Drive
